令 $u=\ln y-\sin x$，则 $\left.\frac{dz}{dx}\right|_{x=0}=\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\right|_{x=0}$

$y-xe^{y-1}=1$ 两边对 $x$ 求导得 $y'-e^{y-1}-xe^{y-1}y'=0\Rightarrow y'=\frac{e^{y-1}}{1-xe^{y-1}}$，又 $y(0)=1$，可得 $y'(0)=1$

在 $y'=\frac{e^{y-1}}{1-xe^{y-1}}$ 两边对 $x$ 求导得

$\left.y''\right|_{x=0}=\left.\frac{e^{y-1}y'(1-xe^{y-1})-e^{y-1}(-xe^{y-1}y'-e^{y-1})}{(1-xe^{y-1})^2}\right|_{x=0}=2$

所以 $\left.\frac{dz}{dx}\right|_{x=0}=\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\right|_{x=0}=f'(0)\left(-\cos x+\frac{1}{y}\cdot\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\bigg|_{x=0}$

$=f'(0)\left(-\cos x+\frac{1}{y}\cdot\frac{e^{y-1}}{1-xe^{y-1}}\right)\bigg|_{x=0}=0$
